text:
The third overall pick in 2025 is getting the full rookie education in Chicago. Anton Frondell has 9 points in 19 games at 16:55 a night, and the hard part has been at five on five, where the Blackhawks are getting just 36% of the expected goals (the quality of chances) with him on the ice. That is a heavy number, but it comes with context: Evolving-Hockey's look at his 12 games last season found him playing with some of the weakest teammates in the league.

His last ten games tell the same story twice. He has 3 points where our numbers expected about 6, and his team scored 6 goals with him on the ice against roughly 9.5 deserved. He is also shooting 8.8%, under our range. There is talent here: his hardest shot sits in the 98th percentile, and he put 9 shots on Boston on Halloween, scoring twice.

The change to watch is his linemates. Patrick Kane came off injured reserve this week, and The Athletic's Scott Powers reported he skated with Andrew Mangiapane and Frondell. Better finishers beside him are the quickest fix for that assist column.
